Features

Everything you need to manage Facebook pages at scale

From scheduling to analytics, Veloxify provides a complete toolkit for creators and teams who take their Facebook presence seriously.

Pages Management

Connect and manage all your Facebook pages from a single, intuitive dashboard. Switch between pages instantly, monitor activity, and keep everything organized.

  • Centralized control for all pages
  • Instant page switching
  • Real time activity monitoring
  • Organized workspace

Post Scheduler

Plan and schedule your content weeks in advance. Our visual calendar makes it easy to see your content pipeline and never miss an optimal posting window.

  • Visual content calendar
  • Optimal time suggestions
  • Bulk scheduling
  • Draft and queue system

Analytics Dashboard

Track what works with detailed performance analytics. Understand your audience, measure engagement, and make data driven decisions to grow your pages.

  • Engagement metrics
  • Audience insights
  • Growth tracking
  • Exportable reports

Content Pipeline

Streamline your content creation workflow from ideation to publication. Collaborate with your team, get approvals, and maintain a consistent posting schedule.

  • Ideation to publication flow
  • Team collaboration
  • Approval workflows
  • Content templates

Team Roles

Assign granular permissions to your team members. Control who can publish, review, or manage settings. Perfect for agencies managing multiple client accounts.

  • Granular permissions
  • Role based access
  • Activity audit logs
  • Client separation

Multi Profile Tokens

Connect multiple authentication tokens per page for enhanced reliability and team workflows. Never lose access to your pages due to a single token expiration.

  • Multiple tokens per page
  • Automatic failover
  • Token health monitoring
  • Secure credential storage

Monetization Insights

Understand which content drives revenue. Track monetization metrics, identify top performing posts, and optimize your content strategy for maximum returns.

  • Revenue tracking
  • Top performing content
  • Monetization optimization
  • Earnings reports
